description: AIDLC lifecycle hooks. Requires `hooks = true` under [features] in .codex/config.toml.

hooks.command: bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Blocked: command guard unavailable (jq not installed)" >&2; exit 2; }; R="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; G="$R/scripts/guard-command.sh"; [ -f "$G" ] || { echo "Blocked: command guard not found at $G" >&2; exit 2; }; cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); exec bash "$G" "$cmd"'
echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"AIDLC session start: follow aidlc/common/session-lifecycle.md (get bearings + handoff)."}}'
